# National Association of Secretaries of State (NASS)

> NASS is the national organization representing Secretaries of State and Lieutenant Governors across all U.S. states and territories, coordinating on election administration, business services, cybersecurity, and state government operations.

NASS serves as the primary coordinating body for state election officials and secretaries of state, providing leadership on election security, business registration services, and interstate policy coordination. The organization operates through specialized committees and maintains corporate affiliate partnerships to advance its mission.

## Key Topics

- Secretaries of State

## Leadership & Governance

- [NASS Executive Board](https://www.nass.org/committees/executive-board): NASS Executive Board leadership including Michael Watson, Steve Hobbs, and other officers
- [About NASS Committees](https://www.nass.org/committees): Overview of NASS committee structure including Elections and Technology committees

## Committees & Operations

- [NASS Elections Committee](https://www.nass.org/committees/elections-committee): Elections Committee members and election administration oversight responsibilities
- [NASS Technology and Security Committee](https://www.nass.org/committees/technology-security-committee): Technology and Security Committee addressing cybersecurity and election administration
- [NASS Securities Committee](https://www.nass.org/committees/securities-committee): Securities Committee coordinating with NASAA on securities regulation and state oversight
- [NASS International Relations Committee](https://www.nass.org/committees/internatl-relations-committee): International Relations Committee with Elaine Marshall overseeing foreign policy and diplomacy

- [NASS Memberships](https://www.nass.org/memberships): Overview of NASS membership types including Secretaries of State and corporate affiliates
- [Roster of Secretaries of State/Lieutenant Governors](https://www.nass.org/memberships/secretaries-statelieutenant-governors): Directory roster of NASS member Secretaries of State and Lieutenant Governors by region
- [About the NASS Corporate Affiliate Program](https://www.nass.org/membership/corporate-affiliates/about-nass-corporate-affiliate-program): Information about NASS Corporate Affiliate Program sponsorship levels and benefits

## Initiatives & Services

- [Initiatives](https://www.nass.org/initiatives): Overview of NASS initiatives including election security, business services, and notarization
- [Business Services](https://www.nass.org/initiatives/business-services): Business Services initiative covering UCC filings, notary services, and corporate registration
